goal: Remove AssumeUTXO and multi-chainstate infrastructure across Bitcoin Core
Eliminate pervasive validation, caching, and syncing complexity that outweighs real-world adoption
reviewability: Ready to review as an architectural demo showing the simplifications of removing AssumeUTXO
agreement: Concept approval because multiple chainstates add high maintenance costs and weaken trust (ismaelsadeeq)
Unaddressed objection: losing AssumeUTXO harms fast bootstrapping, drop background sync first (Sjors)
Suggests keeping AssumeUTXO as an optional IPC companion process to limit maintenance burden (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it removes pervasive multi-chainstate complexity across the most critical subsystem
Routine validation changes would no longer need to handle separate chainstate roles and caches
